steps.content: The town basks in perfect tranquility during the day, as no one except you and your fellow players knows about the madness from the previous round, thanks to the restart.
Besides the Clergyman, no one mourns for the Butcher.

steps.speaker: Timid Child
steps.content: ...Sir, Mom told me to thank you for getting rid of that scary Butcher. He was a bad guy, right?
steps.female_content: ...Ma'am, Mom told me to thank you for getting rid of that scary Butcher. He was a bad guy, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you think he was?

steps.speaker: Timid Child
steps.content: I don't know... Mom and Dad both say so.

steps.speaker: Timid Child
steps.content: He even saved me once. How could this happen... Was it all the Witch's fault?
Everyone congratulates you for heroically defeating "the Witch's minion." But you remember the moment when the Butcher vanished, he transformed back into just an ordinary guy.
The one responsible for this transformation is the mastermind behind this murder mystery game. She shows up from time to time, as if toying with everyone.
You clench your fist silently, vowing to expose her as quickly as possible.
[Insert footstep sound effect]

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: Still shaking? Here, drink something warm.
The Clergyman hands you a cup of warm water. The man's voice is gentle and calm, as if attentively soothing your unease.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Thanks. No need to use your skill on me. I'm fine.
You shrug at the Clergyman. His skill is like some low-cost passive ability that activates automatically from time to time.
Though it certainly makes you feel better, you're repulsed by the idea of being healed by Mania.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: This is just a game.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: The physical seal can only delay the Butcher's respawn briefly. He seems to have lost control already. This way... is better for everyone.
You look up, taking the opportunity to study the Clergyman carefully. Since entering this game, he's remained consistently unfazed, calmly accepting every unexpected development.
At the end of the first round, you think you saw him leave the scene early. Could he have known in advance how things would turn out?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Neither you nor the Butcher is a first-time player, are you?
You're testing him, uncertain of his true purpose or if he'll answer your questions. But right now, he seems to be your only potential source of information.

The Clergyman stands in the shadow of the Witch's statue in the square, not immediately answering you. He crouches down and gently wipes away dirt from the statue with his fingers. Unlike the joy and fervor surrounding him, he appears strangely indifferent and serene.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: This isn't a good place to talk.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: I work at the church. There's hardly anyone around when I'm organizing the archives.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: If you have any questions... come find me at the church.
